endpoint_closure.statement: For two distinct triangular faces {r,a,b} and {r,c,d}, if P_ra=P_rc and P_rb,P_rd lie on the same ray of r from that point, then P_rb=P_rd. If both endpoint pairs coincide, the faces share an arrangement edge and their apexes lie in opposite open halfplanes of r.
endpoint_closure.proof: A face side has no arrangement vertex in its relative interior. Two distinct points on one ray are ordered, so the nearer would subdivide the side ending at the farther. Two distinct cells incident with one arrangement edge occupy opposite sides.
endpoint_closure.scope: all distinct affine straight-line arrangements, including parallels and arbitrary finite multipoints

simple_perturbation.statement: If M(S) selected triangular faces have a finite multipoint vertex, then |S|-M(S) <= a3_simple(n). Thus n=12,target=39 and a3_simple(12)=37 force at least two multipoint-incident selected faces.
simple_perturbation.proof: Faces with only simple vertices are defined by finitely many strict direct-gap inequalities. One sufficiently small generic coefficient perturbation preserves all of them while removing finite concurrencies and parallels; intersections created from formerly parallel distinct lines escape to infinity.
simple_perturbation.provenance: a3_simple(12)=37 from Blanc's exact simple-arrangement result

four_line_prime.statement: Every four-line subset supports at most K(4)=2 selected faces.
four_line_prime.encoding: four ternary all-negative prime clauses per four-line subset

implementation.default_stability: Legacy --sector-bounds and --shared-ray-bounds DIMACS outputs remain byte-identical to the prior release in n=8 controls.

controlled_benchmarks.solver: CaDiCaL 1.9.5 via PySAT; same process and formulation family

sat_controls.n9_target21: SAT with endpoint+k4 and inactive simple-bound 21

controlled_benchmarks.conclusion: Endpoint closure is a sound solver-diversity cut with an n=8 gain and n=9 regression. Multipoint incidence lowers conflicts in the full n=8 control but is not a general wall-time speedup.

exact_face_reification.reason: accepted exact n=10/n=12 witnesses and improved n=8 UNSAT, but n=9 SAT and UNSAT controls became dramatically slower

zero_aware_grassmann_plucker.reason: no base-relaxation violation found through n=7; endpoint n=8 runtime increased from 18.167 to 35.502 seconds

verification.independent_review: No P1 soundness defect. Three P2 issues were fixed: reified heredity now uses direct subset caps, the n=12 witness is called a record rather than an optimum, and endpoint closure explicitly requires distinct faces.

promotion_gate: SAT requires exact rational realization and verification. UNSAT requires a proof-producing rerun and independent proof checking. Live discovery runs change no theorem.
